CustomField.description: Admin-tunable reCAPTCHA v3 score threshold used for monitoring/review guidance only - this system never auto-blocks based on score. Per ECRMSF-5511 reference guidance: 0.8-1.0 = low risk, 0.5-0.7 = monitor, below 0.5 = additional review recommended. This field holds a single reviewer-guidance threshold value; exact usage is determined by the fraud alert Flow, not hardcoded in Apex.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Admin-tunable reCAPTCHA v3 score threshold used for monitoring/review guidance only - never used to auto-block. See field description for Google's reference scoring guidance.
CustomField.label: reCAPTCHA v3 Score Threshold
